## Checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavioral changes.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Generated references are fresh when applicable.
- [ ] I did not use sealed holdout material for tuning.
- [ ] I separated post-selected R&D from independent evidence.
- [ ] User-facing docs and examples reflect contract changes.
